rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the Lord's hidden nature
abstract noun as subject of prajāyate
verb with prefix pra from root jan

items.question: How does knowing the hidden true nature of the Lord produce all-knowingness in the bound soul?
premises: The soul knows the hidden true nature.
items.inference: Knowledge of the Lord's hidden true nature causes all-knowingness to arise.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of sarvajñatvam is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
